en.topic_title: In Pictures: Hong Kong sex work exhibition explores violence and bodily autonomy in an underground industry
en.topic_summary:
Boxes of condoms, AI-generated photos of sex workers, and a computer opened up to a part-time girlfriends website sit inside Heath, an event space in Tsim Sha Tsui.



AI-generated posters of sex workers at A Body of One’s Own, an exhibition about sex work in Hong Kong, at Heath in Tsim Sha Tsui. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



The venue is perhaps a fitting one for A Body of One’s Own, an exhibition spotlighting the history of sex work in Hong Kong. Located in the basement of Chungking Man
